Physical constants

Constants often needed for atmospheric calculations.

Details

SymbolDescriptionUnits
R.starUniversal gas constantJ/K/mol
R.airSpecific gas constant for dry airJ/kg/K
R.h2oSpecific gas constant for water vaporJ/kg/K
k.bBoltzmann constantJ/K
N.AAvogardo number (number of atoms/molecules in one mole)1/mol
mu.airMolecular weight of dry airg/mol
mu.h2oMolecular weidht of waterg/mol
T.0Freezing point of waterK
PP.0Standard ambient sea level pressurehPa
F.0Solar constantW/m2
g.0Average gravity of Earthm/s2
